rows.text_en: Ministry of National Defense ( Education and Training Policy Division ), 02-748-6243

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 학생군사교육실시령(이하 “영”이라 한다)의 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters necessary for the implementation of the Student Military Education Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”).
[Wholly Amended July 27, 1989]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(학칙) 영 제4조제1항에 따른 학칙에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2016. 11. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (School Regulations) The school regulations pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall include the following matters: <Amended Nov. 29, 2016>
1. Purpose of Establishing the ROTC Officer Candidate Program

rows.source_ko: 2. 학군 군간부후보생과정의 교과내용 및 그 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the curriculum and operation of the ROTC officer candidate course

rows.source_ko: 3. 학생군사교육단의 조직 및 영 제4조제2항에 따른 예비역 교관(이하 “예비역 교관”이라 한다)의 인사 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the organization of the Reserve Officers' Training Corps and the personnel management of reserve instructors pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Presidential Decree (hereinafter referred to as “reserve instructors”)

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 군사교육의 실시에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters necessary for the implementation of military education
[This Article was newly established on June 22, 2007.]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(군사교육요원대표자의 회의참여) 영 제4조제2항에 따라 국방부장관이 파견하는 학생군사교육요원의 대표자 또는 예비역 교관의 대표자는 당해학교의 학군 군간부후보생군사교육에 관한 회의에 참여한다. <개정 2007. 6. 22., 2016. 11. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Participation of Representatives of Military Education Personnel in Meetings) Representatives of student military education personnel dispatched by the Minister of National Defense pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, or representatives of reserve instructors, shall participate in meetings concerning the military education of ROTC officer candidates at the relevant school. <Amended Jun. 22, 2007; Nov. 29, 2016>
[Wholly Amended July 27, 1989]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(예비역 교관) ①예비역 교관은 국방부장관이 추천하는 예비역의 장교 및 부사관 중에서 해당 학교의 장이 임용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Reserve Instructors) ① Reserve instructors shall be appointed by the head of the relevant school from among reserve officers and non-commissioned officers recommended by the Minister of National Defense.

rows.source_ko: ②학생군사교육단의 장은 예비역 교관에 대하여 각 군 참모총장이 정하는 바에 따라 업무실적을 평정하여 그 결과를 해당 학교의 장에게 통보할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the Reserve Officers' Training Corps may evaluate the performance of reserve instructors in accordance with the standards set by the Chiefs of Staff of each military branch and notify the head of the relevant school of the results.
[This Article was newly established on June 22, 2007.]
Article 5 Deleted <July 27, 1989>
Article 6 Deleted <December 10, 1985>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(군복착용) ①영 제10조제1항에 따라 예비역 교관과 학군 군간부후보생과정의 교육을 받는 자에 대하여 군복을 착용하게 할 수 있는 경우는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2016. 11. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Wearing of Military Uniform) ① Pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, reserve instructors and persons receiving education in the ROTC officer candidate course may be required to wear military uniforms in the following cases: <Amended Nov. 29, 2016>
1. When conducting military training

rows.source_ko: 2. 시험을 보거나 사열(査閱)을 실시할 때
rows.text_en: 2. When taking an examination or conducting a military inspection

rows.source_ko: 3. 입영교육을 받기 위하여 입영(入營)할 때와 퇴영(退營)할 때
rows.text_en: 3. When enlisting and leaving the camp to receive military training

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따라 예비역 교관이 군복을 착용할 때에는 전역(轉役) 당시의 계급장과 예비군 흉장(胸章)을 부착하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When a reserve instructor wears a military uniform in accordance with Paragraph 1, they must attach the rank insignia and reserve soldier badge from the time of their discharge.
[Wholly Amended June 22, 2007]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(교육시설) 군사교육에 필요한 장비 및 시설은 다음 각호와 같다. <개정 2007. 6. 22., 2015. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Educational Facilities) Equipment and facilities necessary for military education shall be as follows: <Amended Jun. 22, 2007; Jun. 22, 2015>
1. Internal Affairs Guidance Room and Teaching Materials Room
2. Offices of military education personnel or reserve instructors

rows.source_ko: 3. 기타 군사교육 실시에 필요한 시설ㆍ교육장비 및 보조자료
rows.text_en: 3. Other facilities, educational equipment, and auxiliary materials necessary for conducting military education

rows.source_ko: 제9조(장비등 대여) ①국방부장관은 교육부장관과 협의하여 군사교육의 실시를 위하여 필요한 총포 기타 장비를 학군 군간부후보생과정이 지정된 학교의 장에게 대여할 수 있다. <개정 2007. 6. 22., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23., 2016. 11. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Lending of Equipment, etc.) ① The Minister of National Defense may, in consultation with the Minister of Education, lend firearms and other equipment necessary for the implementation of military education to the head of a school designated for the Reserve Officer Training Corps (ROTC) officer candidate course. <Amended June 22, 2007; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013; November 29, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의하여 대여받은 총포 기타 장비의 관리에 관하여는 군수품관리에 관한 법령이 정하는 바에 의한다. <개정 1975. 8. 8.>
rows.text_en: ② The management of firearms and other equipment lent pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall be in accordance with the laws and regulations concerning the management of military supplies. <Amended August 8, 1975>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(보상절차) ①영 제11조의2의 규정에 의하여 보상을 받고자 하는 자는 주소지를 관할하는 지방보훈청장 또는 보훈지청장에게 별지 제5호서식의 증명서를 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Compensation Procedure) ① Any person who wishes to receive compensation pursuant to the provisions of Article 11-2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit a certificate in the form of Annex 5 to the head of the regional office of veterans affairs or the head of the branch office of veterans affairs having jurisdiction over their address.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 증명서는 입영교육을 받던 자의 경우에는 국방부장관이, 교내교육을 받던 자의 경우에는 교육부장관이 각각 발급한다. <개정 1989. 7. 27., 2007. 6. 22., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The certificate referred to in Paragraph 1 shall be issued by the Minister of National Defense in the case of a person undergoing military enlistment education, and by the Minister of Education in the case of a person undergoing on-campus education, respectively. <Amended Jul. 27, 1989; Jun. 22, 2007; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③제2항의 증명서발급권자는 증명서를 발급한 경우에는 그 사실을 지체없이 국가보훈처장에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The certificate issuing authority referred to in Paragraph 2 shall notify the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs of the fact that a certificate has been issued without delay.
[This Article was newly established on Dec. 10, 1985.]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(치료비용의 신청 등) 학교의 장 또는 입영부대의 장은 영 제11조의3의 규정에 의한 치료가 완료된 때에는 그 비용을 교육부장관 또는 국방부장관에게 신청하여야 한다. <개정 1989. 7. 27., 2007. 6. 22., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Application for Treatment Expenses, etc.) When treatment pursuant to the provisions of Article 11-3 of the Enforcement Decree has been completed, the head of a school or the head of an induction unit shall apply to the Minister of Education or the Minister of National Defense for the expenses incurred. <Amended July 27, 1989; June 22, 2007; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013; July 22, 2015>

[This Article was newly established on Dec. 10, 1985.]
[Title amended on July 22, 2015.]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(서식) ①영 제11조의3제1항의 규정에 의한 치료신청서는 별지 제6호서식과 같다. <개정 2015. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Forms) ① The application form for treatment pursuant to Article 11-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as set forth in Annex 6. <Amended July 22, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제11조의3제2항의 규정에 의한 의료시설지정통보는 별지 제7호서식의 통보서에 의한다.
rows.text_en: ② The notification of designation of a medical facility pursuant to the provisions of Article 11-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the notification form in Annex 7.
[This Article was newly established on Dec. 10, 1985.]

rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: ②(일반군사교육이수자의 복무기간단축처리절차에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 학생일반군사교육과정을 이수한 자에 대한 군복무기간의 단축처리절차에 관하여는 종전의 규정에 의한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional measures concerning the processing procedure for shortening the service period of those who have completed general military education) The processing procedure for shortening the military service period for those who have completed the student general military education course at the time of the enforcement of this rule shall be in accordance with the former regulations.

rows.source_ko: ③(서식계속사용에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 삭제되는 종전의 별지 제2호서식 내지 별지 제4호서식은 부칙 제2항의 경우에 이를 계속 사용한다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Transitional Measures Concerning Continued Use of Forms) Forms No. 2 through No. 4 of the Appendix, which are deleted upon the enforcement of this Rule, shall continue to be used in the cases specified in Paragraph 2 of the Addenda.
